items.gist: Initiation is the means for both enjoyment and liberation; eligibility depends on disposition, and different practitioners require different levels of initiation.
External and internal purification through eight baths prepares the practitioner, with mantra-infused water, ash, wind, and sky practices.
Inner and outer sacred seats are distinguished; true spiritual place is the awakened heart, not mere geography.
Matrika and Malini nyasa place letters and powers in the body, restoring and completing mantra efficacy.
Worship unifies the agent and instruments in Shiva; ritual becomes effective through inner oneness rather than mere procedure.
Offerings and vessels are purified by Shiva's light; purity is understood through Shiva-bheda rather than conventional rules.
The practitioner performs threshold, directional, and protective worship, then enters the shrine with mantra and visualization.
The body is worshipped as the full tattva mandala, culminating in Shiva-consciousness and blissful self-identification.
